item.description:
### Added - **Reply to and stop Antigravity CLI sessions from your phone.** An `agy` session running in tmux or herdr now gets the composer and the Stop button on the iPhone and watch, like every other provider. Stop is hidden while the session is waiting on a permission prompt, because there the same key would answer "No" for you. Both were measured before being switched on.
### Fixed - **Devin's background subagents now show up.** Newer Devin runs `explore` subagents in the background, and Perch showed nothing for them — the session looked stuck "running" with no activity while six of them worked. Each now gets its row for as long as Devin waits on it, and the mid-turn "finished" that Devin sends while waiting is ignored as it is for foreground subagents. - **A phone you reinstalled the companion on no longer costs the Mac a write every few seconds.** The old install's push registration was being reserved and released on every fleet change, forever. Perch now skips a registration it already knows will be refused, and forgets one that has been refused for a week. - **Old session records are cleaned up.** Sessions that ended without saying so — a killed agent, or Devin, which never sends a session-end — left their record on disk forever (over a hundred on one Mac). Records untouched for a week are now removed whatever state they were left in; they were already hidden from the fleet.
